title: Vertical curtain wipe (Springs section-entry seam)
source: springs.estate Place->Design section boundary (SEAM-02). Engine = library/components/vertical-curtain-wipe (proven, owns_pin:true, pure render(prog)).
engine: A panel enters as a hard VERTICAL seam wiping L->R and parking at the column split (~50%), while the outgoing full-bleed image crop-zooms (scale up + object-position shift) to stay composed as its column narrows. Pure render(prog); scroll-scrubbed, reversible.
differs: SAME clip-wipe technique on both platforms, but the seam AXIS is rotated to fit the screen (Єгор: a horizontal seam on a tall phone reads as 'two columns squished' — the motion must run along the LONG axis). desktop = HORIZONTAL seam: panel sweeps L->R via inset(right), parks at a vertical split (wide screen splits vertically). mobile = VERTICAL seam: the full-width text-panel rises bottom->top via inset(top), photo stays composed above (tall screen splits horizontally). Both scroll-scrubbed while pinned + crop-zoom on the outgoing image.

desktop.driver: scrollWipe — render(prog): HORIZONTAL clip-seam L->R (inset right) + crop-zoom, parks at vertical split.

mobile.driver: renderMobile(prog): VERTICAL clip-seam bottom->top (inset top) — full-width panel rises, photo above + crop-zoom. Axis rotated for the tall screen.

park.what: where the seam stops (column split, % from left).

pinFactor.what: pin length = innerHeight*pinFactor (drives scroll span; the demo pin-wrap overrides to ~200vh).

engine_patch: forceMotion (skip the <=820px static guard; the dual wrapper owns the mobile branch) + manualDrive (expose render() WITHOUT the engine's own ScrollTrigger/pin, so the wrapper drives render(prog) from scroll on both platforms). Both additive & opt-in; default (no flags) = original desktop-only behaviour. render(prog) logic lives once in the engine. See memory dual-platform-forcemotion + mobile-is-pinned-scroll.
entry: VerticalCurtainWipeDual.init(target, opts). Load engine.js THEN component.js. target = .vcw-stage. Markup: .vcw-stage > .vcw-out(img, the crop-zooming media) + .vcw-panel(the entering panel, clip-revealed L->R to park%). Both platforms wrap the stage in .pin-wrap (sticky pin).
law: render(prog) PURE; clip-path (inset) + transform (scale) only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL. reduced-motion -> render(1) (fully wiped-in, panel parked + image composed). window.__LAB_OK__ on init.
